<compartment start="760" end="848" title="HLS segment numbering migration from 5-digit to 9-digit indices" episode_type="refactor,infra" importance="74">
<p1>
The transcoder's HLS output was using `segment_%05d.ts` — five digits, max 99,999 segments. For a 24/7 live channel at 6s segments that's ~7 days before wraparound, and we just hit a wraparound on `channel-news-east` Friday night that broke the playlist sliding window for ~40 minutes before paging on-call noticed.

Migrated to `segment_%09d.ts` everywhere. Touched `transcoder/hls/segmenter.go` for the writer, `transcoder/hls/playlist.go` for the manifest builder, and the CDN purge job's glob in `ops/purge-stale-segments.sh`. The CDN cache config didn't need changes — the glob was already `segment_*.ts`. Backfill is a no-op because old playlists naturally roll off the sliding window within an hour.

Codified in the writer: any future segment-index format change must keep monotonic ordering AND must always be lexicographically sortable. The 5-digit choice was actually fine lexicographically until wraparound — the failure mode was running out of namespace, not ordering.
</p1>
<p2>
HLS segment naming widened from `%05d` to `%09d` after a live-channel wraparound broke playlist sliding-window on `channel-news-east`. Changes in `transcoder/hls/segmenter.go` and `transcoder/hls/playlist.go`. Naming rule documented: segment indices must always be zero-padded to remain lexicographically sortable, with enough digits for a year of continuous segments at our minimum segment duration.
</p2>
<p3>
HLS segment indices widened after a live-channel index wraparound.
</p3>
<p4>
segment_%09d.ts; transcoder/hls/
</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* HLS segment filename format: `segment_%09d.ts` (writer in `transcoder/hls/segmenter.go`, manifest builder in `transcoder/hls/playlist.go`).
</CONFIG_VALUES>
<PROJECT_RULES>
* HLS segment indices must be zero-padded to a width sufficient for at least one year of continuous output at the minimum supported segment duration. Lexicographic sortability is required for CDN purge globbing.
</PROJECT_RULES>
</facts>
<events>
<causal_incident at_compartment="5">
  <summary>Live channel playback window broke for ~40 minutes after HLS segment index wrapped from 99,999 back to 0.</summary>
  <affected_surface>edit_pipeline</affected_surface>
  <symptom>Playlist sliding window on `channel-news-east` stopped advancing; viewers saw frozen live feed for ~40 minutes.</symptom>
  <cause_summary>5-digit segment index namespace exhausted on a continuously-running channel; new segments lexicographically sorted before old ones, breaking the manifest builder's ordering assumption.</cause_summary>
  <disposition>fixed</disposition>
  <evidence>On-call paged on viewer drop in channel-news-east; logs showed segment files alternating between `segment_99998.ts` and `segment_00000.ts` in the same directory.</evidence>
  <fix_summary>Widened format to `segment_%09d.ts` across writer, manifest builder, and CDN purge glob.</fix_summary>
</causal_incident>
</events>

<compartment start="1278" end="1389" title="Tesseract pinned to 5.3.3 after multi-column regression in 5.3.4" episode_type="bug,infra" importance="46">
<p1>
Document OCR accuracy dropped from ~96% to ~71% on bank-statement-shaped PDFs after the weekly base-image rebuild. Diff'd the rebuild — only relevant change was tesseract bumped from 5.3.3 to 5.3.4 by the apt source. Ran golden-set evaluation against both: 5.3.4 regresses badly on multi-column layouts (column-detection heuristic in LSTM postprocessing changed). Single-column docs unaffected.

Pinned tesseract to 5.3.3 in `docker/ocr/Dockerfile` via explicit apt version and SHA pin, opened upstream issue #4117 with a minimal repro. Will revisit on next minor.
</p1>
<p2>
Tesseract 5.3.4 introduced a regression in multi-column layout detection that dropped our OCR accuracy from 96% to 71% on bank statements. Pinned to 5.3.3 in `docker/ocr/Dockerfile`. Upstream issue #4117 filed.
</p2>
<p3>
Tesseract pinned to 5.3.3 due to a multi-column regression in 5.3.4.
</p3>
<p4>
tesseract=5.3.3; docker/ocr/Dockerfile; upstream #4117
</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* `docker/ocr/Dockerfile` pins `tesseract-ocr=5.3.3` with apt version + SHA pin. Unpin only after upstream #4117 resolves.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
<CONSTRAINTS>
* Tesseract 5.3.4 regresses multi-column layout detection (column-detection heuristic in LSTM postprocessing changed). Single-column accuracy is unaffected.
</CONSTRAINTS>
</facts>
<events>
<causal_incident at_compartment="10">
  <summary>OCR accuracy dropped sharply after weekly base-image rebuild.</summary>
  <affected_surface>environment</affected_surface>
  <symptom>OCR accuracy on multi-column bank statements dropped from 96% to 71%.</symptom>
  <cause_summary>Weekly base-image rebuild pulled tesseract 5.3.4 from apt; the new version's column-detection heuristic regressed on multi-column inputs.</cause_summary>
  <disposition>workaround</disposition>
  <evidence>Golden-set evaluation reproduced the regression isolated to tesseract version with all other deps held constant.</evidence>
  <fix_summary>Pin tesseract to 5.3.3 in `docker/ocr/Dockerfile` until upstream #4117 is resolved.</fix_summary>
</causal_incident>
</events>

<compartment start="39" end="45" title="Narrowed May orders replay" episode_type="infra,investigation" importance="22">
<p1>
Started from a revenue mismatch between Stripe exports and the warehouse and was about to re-run the whole 2025 orders model.
U: don't touch closed months if the hole is just that May gap.

After checking dags/reconcile_orders.py and the landed_at partitions feeding sql/marts/fct_orders.sql, it turned out the drift was isolated to four ingestion days after a connector retry loop. I changed the repair plan to replay only raw.orders_ingest for 2025-05-11 through 2025-05-14, documented the partition command in runbook/backfills.md, and left the rest of the year alone. Commit 2e7af53.
</p1>
<p2>
The warehouse repair stopped being a full-year rebuild once the mismatch traced back to a four-day ingest gap. Replayed only the landed_at partitions for 2025-05-11 through 2025-05-14 and documented the repair command in runbook/backfills.md.
</p2>
<p3>
This was a scoped replay, not a lasting data-model change: the useful outcome was knowing the repair should target landed_at partitions instead of rebuilding closed months.
</p3>
<p4>reconcile_orders.py; landed_at; 2025-05-11..2025-05-14</p4>
</compartment>
<facts>
<CONFIG_VALUES>
* The orders repair workflow is keyed off landed_at partitions rather than invoice_date.
</CONFIG_VALUES>
</facts>

<trajectory_correction at_compartment="5">

  <before_strategy>Re-run the full 2025 orders reconciliation to eliminate the revenue mismatch.</before_strategy>
  <correction_source>user</correction_source>
  <correction_signal>U: don't touch closed months if the hole is just that May gap.</correction_signal>
  <after_strategy>Trace the mismatch to its ingestion window and replay only the affected landed_at partitions.</after_strategy>
  <evidence>The investigation isolated the issue to raw.orders_ingest for 2025-05-11 through 2025-05-14, and the final repair command targeted only that range.</evidence>
</trajectory_correction>
</events>

<compartment start="562" end="578" title="总协调裁定 SC-02-09 需真实迟到返回；我纠正不可达论证并交付 barrier 与 SC-02-10 终态注入" episode_type="design,feature,bug" importance="68">
<p1>
[562] U: 总协调裁定——SC02-09 必须以**真实迟到返回**实现：旧算法调用已取得旧版本输入并延迟返回、待新版本成功后旧结果才返回，**不得以静态 revision 守卫代替证据**；明确允许**必要的 D 测试端口/适配上下文最小扩展**，但不改业务判定；优先"输入可识别标记 / 测试实例隔离的有界 barrier + 超时清理 + 生产禁用 + 无公共 HTTP 后门 + 不只改 DB"。两份复验手册须落盘本分支 `backend/handoffs/B-seam-repro.md` 随交付提交。

[563-565] 我先读码后得出**与裁定前提冲突的结论并如实上报**：`_retake_result`（`assessment_analyze.py:519-553`）返回 `HandlerResult(business_tx=tx)`，`tx` 内执行 `_MARK_RETAKE` ⇒ 按 `runtime/complete.py:179,187-189`（business_tx 先在同一连接/事务执行）`needs_retake` 与任务 `complete_success` **同事务原子提交**；而 `_mark_analyzing` 是自有短事务（`:239`），在调用 provider 前已提交 `analyzing`；A02 要求 `needs_retake` ⇒ 不存在"T05 已 needs_retake 且旧执行仍在飞"的窗口。`git diff --check 5bd22d3..HEAD` rc=0（`d312d2a` 已修 EOF 空行）。

[566-567] fix-2 的严格布尔解析修复终结：`strict_env_bool` 只接受 `1/true/yes/on` 与 `0/false/no/off`，未知值抛 `ProviderConfigError`；`REQUIRED_VIEWS=,,,` fail fast；`double_injection_overrides()` 与 `storage.py` 运行时读取复用同一解析（单一语义）。pytest 259 → **279 passed**；Oracle 4 条命令均 rc=1 且报错含变量名与值域。改动仅 `dconfig.py`/`media/storage.py`/`test_double_injection_seams.py`。

[568-574] 总协调指出候选路径——**租约过期后同一旧任务被另一执行者接管、接管者返回 needs_retake 而原 provider 仍在飞**——我**承认我此前的不可达论证没有覆盖它**。源码证据：`expire.py:41-47` 把 `status='running' AND lease_until < now` 重置 queued；`claim.py:26-41` 接管改写 `lease_owner`、`lease_revision+1`；`complete.py:179-186` business_tx 不符即抛 `StaleGeneration` 整体回滚；`assessment_analyze.py:176-190` 捕获记 `analyze.fenced_write_stale`；`_publish:705-727` 另有 processing_revision/report_ready 守卫；`config.py:24-25,70-75` 已有 `MVP_WORKER_LEASE_SECONDS`/`MVP_WORKER_RENEW_INTERVAL_SECONDS` ⇒ **测试租约配置无需关闭租约机制**。我亲验 fix-2 严格布尔修复（4 条命令 rc=1）后提交 **`40f5fde`**（279 passed rc=0），派发 SC-02-09 barrier + SC-02-10 终态注入（同属 Python worker 写域，单道串行）。

[575-577] 系统提示"某作业无终结结果"与 Board `running [resumed]` 矛盾；我用只读 `task_status` 核实 fix-2 `state: busy`/idle 32s/possibly_stuck false，磁盘探针证实其正在活跃写入（`dconfig.py`/`providers.py`/新测试文件时间戳递进）⇒ **第三次确认为假信号**，不重派/不取消/不回退/不进入其写域。

[578] fix-2 终结两项：(A) `LateReturnBarrier`（`providers.py:163-229`）——文件态、一次性、有界、输入标记（照片内容 sha256）驱动的"先算后等"迟到返回；`os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL)` 建 `consumed`（接管者见之立即返回不被阻塞）、`FaceDouble.quality` 先算 `QualityResult` 再 `compute_then_wait`（不重算）、monotonic deadline + 0.1s 轮询、超时抛既有 `ProviderUnavailable`、`finally` 清理、**不触任何 DB**。(B) `MVP_D_SKIN_DOUBLE_INVALID`（`none|unknown_metric|out_of_range|bad_unit`），经既有 `_ContractViolation` 路径 **1 轮确定性**到达 `status='failed'`+`failure_code='PROVIDER_CONTRACT_VIOLATION'`。5 个新旋钮入 `DOUBLE_INJECTION_SWITCHES`。pytest 279 → **291 passed**。**如实标注 SC-02-09 整体未 PASS**：仅 worker 侧围栏子序列已实测可达（A_in_barrier→recover_expired→B_takeover→B_committed needs_retake→A_released_old_result→A_fenced StaleGeneration），步骤 4-5（Java HTTP）该道无法驱动。
</p1>
<p2>
总协调裁定 SC-02-09 必须真实迟到返回、不得用静态 revision 守卫，允许多个 D 测试端口/适配上下文最小扩展。我起初论证该时序结构性不可达（needs_retake 与 complete_success 同事务原子），但总协调指出租约过期+接管路径后**我承认论证范围有误**：`expire.py` 重置 running→queued、`claim.py` 接管 lease_revision+1、`complete.py` 的 StaleGeneration 围栏，使"接管者写 needs_retake 而原 provider 仍在飞"可达。提交严格布尔修复 `40f5fde`（279 passed）后派发 barrier + SC-02-10：`LateReturnBarrier` 文件态一次性先算后等不写 DB、`MVP_D_SKIN_DOUBLE_INVALID` 1 轮终态；291 passed；SC-02-09 整体未 PASS（Java 步骤留给 E）。
</p2>
<p3>
总协调裁定 SC-02-09 需真实迟到返回；我先误判不可达、后经总协调提示租约接管路径纠正，交付文件态 `LateReturnBarrier` 与 SC-02-10 确定性终态注入。
</p3>
<p4>
LateReturnBarrier; 40f5fde; 租约接管可达性; MVP_D_SKIN_DOUBLE_INVALID; 291 passed
</p4>
</compartment>

<compartment start="579" end="591" title="独立核验 barrier/SC-02-10 并提交 181676d；补齐 b40/b41 端到端工装" episode_type="feature,investigation" importance="60">
<p1>
我独立核验 fix-2 的 barrier 与 SC-02-10（不采信自报）：写域恰 `dconfig.py`/`providers.py` + 新测试（业务文件 diff 全空，含 `assessment_analyze.py`/`runtime/**`/`media/storage.py`/Java/acceptance）；`LateReturnBarrier` 用 `os.open(O_CREAT|O_EXCL)` 建 `consumed`（接管者见之立即返回）、标记取输入照片内容 sha256、先算后等、monotonic deadline 有界、`finally` 清理、不写任何 DB。我亲跑 pytest **291 passed rc=0**；守卫 CLI 七组符合预期（生产+barrier rc=1 且列明 switch、生产+全默认 rc=0、dev+全合法非默认 rc=0、缺 sha256/坏 sha/坏枚举/timeout=0 均 rc=1）。

核心测试方法论**确为真实围栏路径而非种库伪造时序**（Oracle 上轮正因种库判 BLOCKER）：`_seed_marked_case`（:114 明写"仅初始 fixture"）只建 v1 初始任务；随后 `claim_batch(worker_id="A", lease_seconds=1)` 真实领取、真实线程中 `handle` 先算出旧结果再阻塞、`_wait_file(consumed)` 确认已阻塞、`time.sleep(1.2)` 让短租约自然过期（未关闭续租机制：单次 handle 无续租线程）、`recover_expired` 真实回收并断言 `status='queued'`/`lease_owner is None`/`lease_revision+1`、再由 `claim_batch(worker_id="B", lease_seconds=60)` 真实接管。尾部断言真实非空跑：`complete_success` 对旧执行抛 `StaleGeneration`、`needs_retake` 未被覆盖、`report_id`/`report_payload`/`member_id` 为 null、`report_ready` 行数 0、无 sentinel 残留。SC-02-10 断言 `attempt_count==1`、`failure_code=PROVIDER_CONTRACT_VIOLATION`、`async_jobs` 计数 == 1、`report_ready`=0。提交 **`181676d`**（相对 `5bd22d3` 13 文件/+2370−11，diff-check rc=0）。

随后派发 b40/b41 端到端工装（步骤 4-5 属 Java HTTP，Python 道无法驱动；该证据须由我自有验收工装 `backend/tests/**` 产出，否则 Oracle 极可能再判"未证明真实可驱动"）。[591] fix-2 终结：`backend/tests/run-acceptance-b.sh` + `support/b-checks-3.sh` 新增 **b40**（SC-02-09 真实迟到返回：A01 → A 在飞 → 租约过期 `--recover` → B 接管写 needs_retake → A02 v2 → C 发布 → 释放 A → 旧执行被 `job.complete_stale_generation` 围栏拒绝、v2 快照不变）与 **b41**（SC-02-10 终态 + M3-A03 投影一致）。完整工装 **41/41 ALL PASS SCRIPT_RC=0**（b36 Java 419/0/0、b37 Python 291/0/0）。
</p1>
<p2>
我独立核验 barrier 与 SC-02-10：写域仅 `dconfig.py`/`providers.py`+测试，`LateReturnBarrier` 一次性先算后等不写 DB，测试走真实 `claim/recover/handle/complete` 围栏（`_seed_marked_case` 仅初始 fixture）且尾部断言 `StaleGeneration` 与快照不变；291 passed。提交 `181676d` 后派发 b40/b41：b40 端到端真实迟到返回、b41 终态+M3-A03 投影，工装 **41/41 SCRIPT_RC=0**。
</p2>
<p3>
核验 barrier/SC-02-10 后提交 181676d；b40/b41 端到端工装补齐，41/41 全绿。
</p3>
<p4>
181676d; b40/b41; 41/41; LateReturnBarrier 真实围栏路径
</p4>
</compartment>

<compartment start="592" end="597" title="核验 b40/b41 红线并提交最终代码 SHA 8343ba5，送 Oracle 有界复审" episode_type="investigation,release" importance="62">
<p1>
我独立核验 b40/b41，重点三条红线：**有无直接改 DB 伪造时序**、**b1–b39 断言有无弱化**、**亲跑工装**。grep 命中的 `UPDATE async_jobs`/`INSERT INTO` 全在既有检查区（第 107/129/141/157/200/258 行），而新增代码区从 **315 行**起（`b_drain_queue`）、b40 在 384、b41 在 505 ⇒ **新增区零业务表写入**；`b_drain_queue` 用真实 `-m mvp_worker --once` 消费（注释明写"不直接改状态"）；`psql_b` 调用全为 SELECT。b1–b39 无断言被弱化（删除行仅 3 行头注释改名，numstat +14/−2 与 +266/−1）。b40 的后台 Worker A 有专门回收钩子（pid + kill + 10s 等待 + kill -9）。我亲跑完整工装 **ALL PASS 41/41 SCRIPT_RC=0**（跑后 18083/18084 空闲、无遗留 JVM）。提交工装，**本轮最终代码 SHA = `8343ba5`**（相对 `5bd22d3` 15 文件/+2650−14，diff-check rc=0），送 ora-1 只读复审（授权其可跑测试并独占 18083/18084）。

趁复审期间我把 `B-seam-repro.md`（含最终绑定 SHA、b40 实测中间态表与 E 可照抄的 9 步复验序列、等价性说明、双重围栏如实记录、进程卫生）与 `B.md` 13.10/13.11 补齐到当前事实，并更正"端到端缺口"为已闭合并附红线核实（新增区零业务表写入、`psql_b` 全 SELECT、b1–b39 断言零改动），同时明记**场景最终结算由 E 在其 matrix 完成、B 不代 E 宣布 PASS**。
</p1>
<p2>
我核验 b40/b41：新增区零业务表写入、`psql_b` 全 SELECT、b1–b39 断言零改动，亲跑 41/41 SCRIPT_RC=0；提交最终代码 SHA `8343ba5`（15 文件/+2650−14）并送 Oracle 只读复审；同步补齐 `B-seam-repro.md` 与 `B.md` 13.10/13.11。
</p2>
<p3>
核验红线后提交最终代码 SHA 8343ba5，送 Oracle 有界复审，并补齐两份交付文档。
</p3>
<p4>

</p4>
</compartment>

<compartment start="598" end="620" title="Seam 注入轮收尾：修 Oracle 四项证据完整性发现并取得重绑定 PASS（11e42c8）" episode_type="bug,investigation" importance="58">
<p1>
[598] Oracle 对 `8343ba5` 判 PASS-with-notes（21 项逐条闭合、明确许可合入 dev、判 SC-02-09/SC-02-10 注入能力已就绪可由 E 黑盒驱动），但提 3 项新 IMPORTANT + 1 SUGGESTION：①`b-checks-3.sh:481-488` b40 忽略 Worker A 退出码、日志正则过宽（接受任意 `StaleGeneration` 字样或 DEBUG 事件）；②`test_seam_boundary_repro.py:392-406`/`b-checks-3.sh:526-529` 以 `owner_id=assessmentId` 计数不能证明无 `identity.enroll`/`plan.generate` 后继（两类 owner_id 不同）；③`providers.py:163-166`/`dconfig.py:394-469` barrier 开启时 DIR 可为空并回退共享 `/tmp/mvp-double-late-barrier`，未强制 RUN_ID 隔离；④timeout 非数字抛裸 `ValueError`。

我决定四项全修、不接受"明确接受测试约束"——三者都属可能导致假 PASS 的证据完整性缺陷，与"绝不把伪造/受控替代当真实"的纪律直接冲突。派发 fix-2 单道（独占 `dconfig.py`/`providers.py`/`test_seam_boundary_repro.py`/`backend/tests/**`），同时把 Oracle 裁定记入 `B-oracle.md` 4.14、`B.md` 13.11；`B-seam-repro.md` 的 `_DIR` 回退描述刻意等修复落地后再改，避免文档记载尚未实现的行为。

<compartment start="647" end="666" title="Swagger 联调文档：五道并行交付引擎列表展开与四域目录（含显式不透明约定）" episode_type="design,feature" importance="72">
<p1>

<compartment start="705" end="716" title="整改验证：补 requiredProperties 四项、提交 9b5ed34 并送 Oracle 重审" episode_type="feature,investigation" importance="66">
<p1>
fix-4 终结结果送达（证实它并非死亡，只是 Board 簿记滞后——我先前拒绝回退/重派是对的）。静置 200 秒后中央验证：**test-compile rc=0**；`ApiDocsApplierTest` **15/0/0**（12+3）、Guard 7、DisabledIT 1、OpenApiDocsIT 3 全绿；**门禁只剩 4 项**，且全部同一类：`A02Metadata→M3A02Metadata missing=[expectedPhotoVersion, replacedViews] generated=[]`、`A01Metadata→M3A01Metadata missing=[photoVersion, captureSessionId, consentEvidenceRef]`、`M1A01Metadata→M1A01Metadata missing=[capture, consentEvidenceRef]`、`Capture→Capture missing=[captureId, capturedAt, clientContinuityId, purpose]`。这正是新门禁 6b 的**设计意图生效**：这些 multipart metadata 是 record、未用校验注解，故 springdoc 生成 `required=[]`。门禁**不再报 A02 的 part 必填性** ⇒ fix-8 的 `binary(...,false)` 已与契约 `required=['metadata']` 吻合，**BLOCKER 1 端到端闭合**。

写文案前我核实了这 11 个字段：**全部由服务端手工严格校验，只是没用 Bean Validation 注解**——`AssessmentMultipartParser`（`photoVersion :60-61` bigint 串 `"1"`、`captureSessionId :63` requireText、`consentEvidenceRef :64`、`expectedPhotoVersion :73-74`、`replacedViews :76-88` 非空/枚举/去重）与 `MemberAccessGrantController`（`capture :162-163`、`captureId :165`、`clientContinuityId :166`、`consentEvidenceRef :167`、`capturedAt :168→:197-203` 必填且 RFC3339、`purpose :169-170` 须为 `grant`，违规统一 400 `INVALID_INPUT` + `details.fields`）。故正确措辞是"**服务端手工严格校验、但未以注解声明 ⇒ springdoc 生成 required 为空，此处按契约与实际行为修正**"，而**不是**"实现偏差"（后者只适用于 `numbersAsStrings` 那种契约必填而代码真不强制的情形）。我给两个目录各补 `requiredProperties()` 覆写（补 `import java.util.Set;`，javadoc 内附 `文件:行` 取证并明确"这不是实现偏差"）。

中央验证全绿：test-compile rc=0；硬化后门禁 `GATE_RC=0`、1/0/0（4 项归零）；全量 Java **435 run / 0 failures / 0 errors** BUILD SUCCESS（432 + 3 个新引擎单测）；package rc=0、应用 6s UP、`/v3/api-docs` 200、swagger-ui 200、端口已释放。我又犯了同一类相对路径错误（第三次）：脚本前段 `cd backend/web-java` 后 heredoc 仍用相对路径读 `.coordination/...` ⇒ `FileNotFoundError`；抓取本身成功（**415676 字节**，写在绝对路径）。量化显示**两个 BLOCKER 与 I5/I6/I7/C3 均在真实输出中闭合**（A02 `required=['metadata']`、A01/care/grant 与契约逐个相符；`reportSummary` 含三键且不透明标记消失；5 个 schema required 与契约一致；核准不透明集恰 3 项；无结构自由字段 0；`JsonNode`/`PrincipalContext`/`SuccessEnvelope` 已修剪）。

两处我必须查清而不能想当然：①我"错误陈述应消失"的计数式检查太天真（`同事务` 2 次、`deny-all`/`owner-dev`/`any-authenticated` 各 1 次）——极性核查证明**文案是对的、我的检查是错的**：三处都在 fix-6 修正后的否定句里（"原 deny-all 不再生效、owner-dev 与 any-authenticated 便利已全部移除"）⇒ IMPORTANT 4 闭合；`同事务` 两处都不是登出那句（一处在通知目标描述、T09 确为单条原子 UPDATE；一处在 `reportSummary`、Worker publish 确在同一 business_tx），均准确。②我上一轮报的"`JsonNode` 悬空引用"是**假警报**：`JsonNode` 在整份文档只出现 1 次，位于 `info.description` 散文（"Object/Map/JsonNode"），我的 `count('/JsonNode')` 恰好命中；做全量 `$ref` 完整性校验得 **384 个引用、0 个悬空**。IMPORTANT 3 确已闭合：登出描述现为"先从当前会话/提供方撤销会话（SessionProvider，当前为内存替身；**不在 DB 事务中**）…**会话撤销与 T09 更新不是同一事务**…幂等补偿，不反转登出结果"，204 描述同口径且 `has content = False`。

至此 Oracle 七项发现**全部在真实输出中验证闭合**。提交整改 **`9b5ed34a6bd669ebc4726681cb92847264b3a18e`**（本轮相对 dev 基线 `76cd426` 共 12 文件 / +6178 −53、全部 `web/docs/**`、`git diff --check` rc=0；树中只剩我两份文档）。送 Oracle 有界复审新 SHA，聚焦"七项是否真闭合 + 门禁硬化有无新漏洞"，并请求**轮次边界声明**。趁复审期间修正联调指南中已被本轮整改推翻的两条"已知限制"（指南若仍写"multipart 条件必填无法表达"会让联调方按错误前提实现客户端），并把绑定 SHA 更新到 `9b5ed34`；三处编辑中两处失败（我的 `oldString` 写成 `{v}` 而文件是 `{photoVersion}`），取得逐字原文后重新精确替换。
</p1>
<p2>
fix-4 报告证实 Board 异常是簿记滞后。中央验证：test-compile rc=0、`ApiDocsApplierTest` 15/0/0、门禁只剩 4 项——multipart metadata record（A02/A01/M1A01/`Capture`）的契约必填属性因手工校验而无注解、springdoc 看不到。我核实这 11 个字段均由服务端手工严格校验（`AssessmentMultipartParser`、`MemberAccessGrantController`），故正确措辞是"手工严格校验、未以注解声明"，**不是**"实现偏差"。补两个 `requiredProperties()` 覆写后全绿：门禁 `GATE_RC=0` 1/0/0、全量 Java **435/0/0**、`/v3/api-docs` 415676 字节；两个 BLOCKER 与 I5/I6/I7/C3 均闭合。我的计数式"错误陈述"检查被极性核查推翻（deny-all/owner-dev/any-authenticated 在否定句中，正确；两处 `同事务` 均准确），`JsonNode` 悬空引用是假警报（384 引用/0 悬空）。提交 `9b5ed34`（12 文件、+6178/−53）；送 Oracle 有界重审并请求轮次边界声明；开始修指南两条被推翻的限制。

我验证整改：以 `requiredProperties()` 补上剩余 4 项门禁（multipart metadata 属手工校验而非注解声明），确认 Oracle 七项发现在真实 `/v3/api-docs` 输出中全部闭合（门禁绿、全量 Java 435/0/0），提交 `9b5ed34` 并送 Oracle 有界重审。
